basis: Rights-tier policy of docs/plan/specialists/hist-sources-2.md section 3 (recommended) as adopted by chapter 13 WP-DATA-04 and chapter 14 WP-HIST-02. This is a CANDIDATE gate for the data tooling: it classifies CLAIMED sources by name; it does not prove where a value really came from.

tiers.A: public domain, CC0 or notice-only: may be ingested and redistributed
tiers.B: reusable with attribution and/or share-alike: only in separate files with per-record licence + attribution surface
tiers.C: link-out only: never fetch, store, embed, or feed to a model
tiers.legacy: already shipped before the gate existed; passes L001 until DG-3 only if listed in the retro-audit with a decided action

patterns.why: (c) Steve A. Hawks, no reuse licence found (hist-sources-2 SRC-41)
non-commercial copy-with-attribution only; bulk use needs written permission (hist-sources-2 SRC-39)
CC BY-SA 4.0: attribution and share-alike, none surfaced on the site (WP-DATA-04)
ODbL: attribution and share-alike; separate file required
ToS forbids scraping and AI use
US Government work (counsel to confirm the pre-1931 basis)
